description: The Catholic parish burial entry attached to Cornelius Driscoll (GJ72-9WD) as SD-DRIS-C, and one half of this corpus's source-vs-source conflict. It records a burial on 14 April 1878 at St. Patrick's Cemetery, Sherbrooke, with a death that April. Its partner, SD-DRIS-D (record-read-driscoll-death-1885), registers a death on 2 February 1885. The two cannot both be right, and a seven-year gap is not the estimated-age variance a census carries — both are records whose dates are exact. What makes this a CONFLICT rather than a defect in one source: the profile records no death date at all, so neither record disagrees with the profile, they disagree with each other; and both carry an indexed birth of 1814 and the same parish, so neither is plainly the wrong man. The indexed birth is how this corpus expresses a stated age at death — no fixture in the repo uses an Age fact type. The audit's job is to characterise the disagreement and route it onward, not to pick a winner, recommend a detach, or write anything. Its collection is deliberately NOT the Drouin one that carries the marriage register: `index_error_source` is the substring "Drouin Collection", and a shared collection title would scope the detach guard to two unrelated sources at once.

facts.place: St. Patrick's Cemetery, Sherbrooke, Quebec, Canada
